matches.basis: Three occupied robots per alliance. Identical starts and nominal 504 FUEL; experimentally assigned target outcomes. The central support robot retains position after AUTO.

endgame.basis: Kickoff V0 sections 5.8 and 6.5. The assigned own-zone slot makes one final choice. Two-inch route arrival is a staging allowance. Separate criteria require actual rung contact, support and clearance. The 9 s L1 service starts at the dock. Higher-level times and all scenario witnesses are assumptions. One tower berth per alliance reserves approach clearance. B2 and R2 are the native R2C-T1 low-rung robot. B1 and R1 are hypothetical multi-level peers with a separate upper-tier drive and no native evidence.
